summary.missableSummary: Only 'Positive Mental Attitude' is flagged as possibly missable — unconfirmed (Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house, per PowerPyx and GTABase). All other 54 trophies are earnable in post-story free roam. Zero online trophies are required.

roadmap.title: Story Playthrough & Chapter 1 Missable Watch
roadmap.subtitle: Chapters 1–5 Campaign + Early Meditation Alert
roadmap.orderNote: Play through the campaign on any approach without enabling cheats (cheats block trophies and saving). Keep an eye on Jason's house in Chapter 1 for the lone potentially missable meditation.
roadmap.warning: POSSIBLY MISSABLE (UNCONFIRMED): During Chapter 1, the morning after 'Down to Earth', follow Lucia onto the balcony at Jason's house, focus on her, and accept the meditation prompt. Community guides (PowerPyx & GTABase) flag this opening meditation for 'Positive Mental Attitude' as potentially missable because GTA VI has no mission replay.
tips: Scan unfamiliar cars, boats, and aircraft with the WAiNK app as you play to make 'Whip It Good' (100 vehicles) and the 100% checklist's 200-vehicle target effortless.
Enable Criminal Profile HUD alerts in Settings > UI so you can see progress toward 'Actions Speak Louder' (500 choices).
Use binoculars on new wildlife whenever you travel across Leonida to build toward the 100-animal study mark for 'A Long Road'.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks Character Strands
roadmap.subtitle: Complete 8 Strands Including All 5 Named Finales
roadmap.orderNote: Once free roam opens up — or right after finishing the story — clear the character arcs for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, and three additional Strangers & Freaks strands.
roadmap.warning: None of the Stranger strands are missable; every strand remains accessible in post-story free roam.
tips: Track purple side-mission markers across Leonida; finishing Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone satisfies 5 of the 8 strands needed for 'Strangers & Freaks'.
Complete Bret's hunting strand early enough to knock out 'Fair Game' and make headway on his 15 hunting targets required for 100% completion.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, Map Discovery & Meditations
roadmap.subtitle: 52 Areas, 18 Meditations, 3 Card Sets, 100 WAiNK Scans & 100 Vehicles
roadmap.orderNote: Sweep Leonida district by district to reveal all 52 map zones, finish the remaining meditation spots with both Jason and Lucia, gather 3 complete Collectible Card sets, and hit 100 WAiNK scans.
roadmap.warning: Use the in-game map filter (magnifying glass) and Progress > Collections menu to see missing spots without retreading cleared zones.
tips: After Chapter 2 ('Coffee Break'), each open-world meditation spot can be performed by both Jason and Lucia separately to reach 18 total meditations.
Hold Up on the D-Pad + R1 near landmarks, sculptures, and curiosities to trigger WAiNK scans; there are well over 100 valid spots across Leonida.

roadmap.title: Activities, Ranges, Races & Stunts
roadmap.subtitle: 42 Shooting Range Golds, 14 Top Fun Drone Races, 20 Races & 250 Stunts
roadmap.orderNote: Tackle the skill-based open-world pastimes. Clearing all 42 Shooting Range golds and all 14 Top Fun Drone Races also directly fulfills full-completion lines on the 100% checklist.
roadmap.warning: Try all 9 distinct activity types at least once for 'Master of None' while working through races, fishing with Cal, and an arcade cabinet.
tips: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge ('Baited My Tackle') and clear a full arcade cabinet run ('Stick Fiddler') such as 'Bang for Your Buck' at Key Lento.
Stack 250 stunts ('Cunning Stunts') and 50 open-world challenges ('One Last Thing') while traveling between races and ranges.

roadmap.title: Heists, Combat Feats, Secrets & Economy
roadmap.subtitle: 5 Bank Vaults, 9 Gang Ops, Hidden Feats, Laundering & Properties
roadmap.orderNote: Clean up the combat, robbery, secret Easter egg, and money trophies. Wait until late game when you have strong gear, cash reserves, and full map access.
roadmap.warning: Every trophy in this stage is repeatable or earnable in post-story free roam.
tips: Hit all 9 gangs' illegal operations ('Pest Control') and 5 bank vaults ('Maximum Withdrawal') while building marked cash to launder $250,000 ('Dime on the Dollar').
Train at fitness clubs together to max Strength for both protagonists ('Personal Best') and spend $100,000 across shops ('Treat Yo Self') plus buy all 8 garages ('Little Boxes').

roadmap.title: 100% Completion & Platinum Cleanup
roadmap.subtitle: Finish Remaining 100% Checklist Items for 'A Long Road' & 'Vice Got a Price!'
roadmap.orderNote: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (unlocked after the campaign) and clear any remaining optional tasks, gang operations, underwater discoveries, animal studies, or vehicle scans.
roadmap.warning: Nothing on the 100% checklist is missable; once 'A Long Road' and all other 53 trophies pop, the Platinum 'Vice Got a Price!' unlocks automatically.
tips: The 100% checklist tracks 35 objectives across Story & Tasks, Exploration & Activities, and Discoveries (including 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 200 vehicle scans, and 100 binocular animal studies).
Double-check Progress > Collections if a counter trophy like 'Actions Speak Louder' (500) is just shy of completion.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: Earnable once all other 54 single-player trophies are unlocked. Watch the single potentially missable trophy ('Positive Mental Attitude') in Chapter 1.
trophies.when: Automatically unlocks when the 54th base-game trophy is earned.
trophies.guide: Unlock every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI's PlayStation 5 list — 2 Gold, 6 Silver, and 46 Bronze — to earn the Platinum. All 55 trophies are single-player with zero online requirements. Follow the 6-stage roadmap: finish the story while grabbing the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for 'Positive Mental Attitude', complete the Stranger strands, sweep collectibles and activities, knock out the secret and heist feats, and close out the 100% completion checklist.
steps: Complete the campaign without activating cheats (cheats disable trophies).
Grab the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house so 'Positive Mental Attitude' stays safe.
Finish all remaining side strands, collectibles, activities, secret feats, and 'A Long Road' (100% Completion).

Fight responding police until your Wanted Level reaches 4 stars.
Duck into tunnels, covered structures, or off-road cover until the 4-star alert clears completely.

trophies.when: Stage 5 — Ideal to chain right into 'Hot Together'.

steps: Mark 3 closely spaced retail shops on the map before starting.
Bring your partner in a fast, sturdy car and rob Store #1 to trigger a Wanted Level.
Drive immediately to Store #2 and Store #3 without letting the Wanted Level expire, robbing both to pop the trophy.

Check varied areas — beaches, marinas, airports, rural highways, and luxury neighborhoods — for distinct models.
Unlock the trophy at 100/100, then keep scanning to 200 for 100% completion.

Activate Combat Focus and land 5 rapid lethal shots before the slow-motion ends.

Rush to a flyable passenger jet or aircraft parked near the runway.
Enter the cockpit, accelerate down the strip, and take off cleanly to unlock the trophy.

Move swiftly to a parked Rhino tank and enter it before soldiers overwhelm you.

Neutralize or bypass cameras and security silently without letting an alarm sound.
Grab the jewelry haul and slip out undetected to unlock 'Sneakthief'.

Park a fast, armored or upgraded getaway car facing an open escape route.
Crack the vault, grab the cash, and fully evade police 5 times to claim this Silver trophy.

Stop the truck, eliminate guards, and breach the rear doors to collect the cash.
Escape and completely clear your Wanted Level to unlock the trophy.

Inspect the world map for any dimmed or unnamed rural zones, islands, and keys.
Fly a helicopter across remaining unvisited areas until all 52 areas are discovered.

Assault and loot at least one operation from each of the 9 distinct gangs.
Continue clearing all 39 operations afterward to satisfy the 100% checklist.

Play naturally through the story, robberies, and 100% checklist while tracking the 0/500 counter.
If any points remain in Stage 5, repeat profile-shifting free-roam actions until 500/500 triggers.
